findings.title: Default manifest hardcodes C:\LocalAI; GRZ_ROOT/${} unused
findings.risk: Relocatable installs, Termux $HOME, Android /data/local/tmp, D: drive, and POSIX trees cannot use the default manifest. expandEnvironment exists but agents.windows.json never uses ${GRZ_ROOT} or similar, so multi-host packaging is blocked.
findings.fix_pack_hint: GRZ_ROOT template manifest — rewrite agents.*.json to ${GRZ_ROOT}/...; document GRZ_ROOT; keep windows absolute as optional override

findings.title: expandEnvironment silently empties missing ${VAR}
findings.risk: Unset GRZ_ROOT/LOCALAI_ROOT becomes empty string, then resolveManifestPath may treat '' as falsy skip or produce nonsense relatives. Failures look like missing models rather than misconfigured env.
findings.fix_pack_hint: Strict ${} expansion — fail loadManifest when referenced env keys are unset

findings.title: start/stop scripts hardcode Codex output tree paths
findings.risk: Scripts break on any other machine, user profile, or git checkout (README points at Documents\green-roomz). Spaces in 'Program Files' are quoted here but Root is not derived from $PSScriptRoot.
findings.fix_pack_hint: Script-relative roots — derive $Root from $PSScriptRoot/..; optional GRZ_ROOT override

findings.title: resolveManifestPath: relative → parent-of-config; no MAX_PATH/\\?\; runtime.command unresolved
findings.risk: Relative policies resolve via config/../policies (works today) but relative runtime.command is never resolved. UNC handled; no \?\ long-path, reserved CON/NUL/PRN, or colon-in-name checks. path.normalize quirks on mixed slash untested.
findings.fix_pack_hint: Path resolve hardening — resolve runtime.command; optional long-path; reject reserved Win names in tests

findings.title: CLI always constructs WindowsHostAdapter; AndroidSidecar never wired
findings.risk: POSIX/Termux/note9 fingerprint and priority path always use Windows adapter. GREEN_ROOMZ_ANDROID_SIDECAR only printed in doctor JSON; no spawn/stop via sidecar. Blocks Gate E / note9 host path.
findings.fix_pack_hint: Host adapter selection — wire AndroidSidecar + posix adapter from env/platform

findings.title: Mixed GGUF case (Qwen3 vs qwen*) brittle on case-sensitive FS
findings.risk: Windows NTFS usually case-insensitive; Linux/Termux/ext4 are not. Copying artifacts with different casing marks agents unavailable with opaque missing paths.
findings.fix_pack_hint: Artifact case canon — document exact on-disk names; optional casefold check in doctor

findings.title: No Job Object / process-group ownership; stop scripts kill by exe name

evidence.snip: PID plus process-group or Windows Job Object identity;
It SHALL NOT kill arbitrary processes by executable name, port, ancestry, or model filename.
owned subprocess lifecycle management without killing unrelated processes;

findings.risk: Operator stop/bench bounce can kill unrelated llama-server (other tools, other GRZ trees). No Job Object means taskkill of node can orphan children. Violates §9.1/acceptance #19 and README claim.
findings.fix_pack_hint: Owned-only stop — stop by recorded PIDs / job object; rewrite stop-*.ps1 to call gateway drain or PID file

findings.title: stopRecord uses POSIX SIGTERM/SIGKILL; no Windows graceful path
findings.risk: On win32, child.kill('SIGTERM') is not a POSIX signal to llama-server; often maps to abrupt terminate. 3s then SIGKILL. No HTTP /exit drain of llama-server. Orphans more likely under McAfee/forced Stop-Process.
findings.fix_pack_hint: Windows graceful stop — prefer runtime /exit or CTRL_BREAK when available; document taskkill vs SIGTERM

findings.title: CLI `stop` is local-empty ProcessManager no-op; does not drain running serve

evidence.snip: stop [--manifest path]   (asks a running local gateway to drain; currently local-process only)

findings.risk: Fresh ProcessManager has empty processes Map; stopAll returns immediately while detached serve + llama-server keep running. Operators fall back to name-based Stop-Process (S-001).
findings.fix_pack_hint: Remote drain stop — HTTP admin drain or PID-file stop against running serve

findings.title: Cold-start health AbortSignal not chained to parent; scripts use fixed sleeps

evidence.snip: Fixed post-launch sleeps SHALL NOT establish readiness.

findings.risk: Client abort only interrupts sleep, not in-flight health fetch; start may continue after disconnect. PS1 readiness is listen-port + sleep, not health/model identity (§9.2).

findings.title: spawn: windowsHide/stdio set; detached unset; orphan on hard kill

evidence.snip: // Resident CPU nexus (tool-router-agent) stays loaded for the life of serve.

findings.risk: Default non-detached is good for tree-kill on Unix, but Windows without Job Object still orphans llama-server when node is killed with /F (McAfee/Stop-Process pattern). Resident nexus amplifies orphan cost.
findings.fix_pack_hint: Job-object spawn wrap — AssignProcessToJobObject on win32 children

findings.title: Offline intent / translation detection is English-lexeme only
findings.risk: Spanish/CJK/Hebrew requests (traducir, 翻訳, תרגם, dibuja) miss offlinePlan and translation_request. Nexus prompts/AVAILABLE are English; far-from-English turns degrade to default_text or wrong specialist.
findings.fix_pack_hint: Multilingual intent lexicon — expand translate/draw/code cues; rely on nexus for non-Latin when live

findings.title: English-only system policies and en_US Piper voice

evidence.snip: You are the Green-Roomz nexus. Emit ONE minified JSON object only:
Translate only when the client explicitly requests translation or a configured workflow declares it.
local text-to-speech with selectable voice, language, speed, and output format.

findings.risk: Nexus/system prompts are English-instruction BPE-friendly; TTS cannot meet 'selectable language' requirement with only en_US. OCR/ASR policies say preserve source language but operator UX assumes Latin UI.
findings.fix_pack_hint: Locale policy pack — voice catalog by lang; optional non-English nexus prompt variant

findings.title: Child log decode uses Buffer.toString() default; no chcp/LANG guidance

evidence.snip: Models stay on disk under `C:\LocalAI` (not in this repo). Node 24+ is enough.

findings.risk: On Windows non-UTF-8 ACP, llama-server CJK/path diagnostics in stderr can mojibake into UnavailableError slices. No docs for chcp 65001 / UTF-8 console / LANG=C.UTF-8 on Termux.
findings.fix_pack_hint: UTF-8 log decode + operator console notes in README/system-requirements

findings.title: grz-src stripControls/headerSafe ahead of session tree

evidence.snip: export function jsonResponse(response, status, body, headers = {}) {

findings.risk: Session tree lacks C0/C1 sanitizer; non-ASCII/control in route reasons can break HTTP headers or console (known-bugs Escape section). qodesh lag compounds platform header issues.
findings.fix_pack_hint: Sync grz-src util/gateway sanitizers into session before pack

findings.title: ASCII toLowerCase for MIME/slash tokens; localeCompare only for profile ids
findings.risk: ASCII protocol tokens are fine with toLowerCase; localeCompare without 'en' can reorder profile ids under exotic locales (low). No NFC/NFD normalization if macOS ever hosts artifacts.
findings.fix_pack_hint: localeCompare('en') + optional Unicode normalize for paths
